description.value: Silvestre is a family-run Peruvian restaurant on Water Street in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, opened by Peruvian immigrants to share the authentic flavours of their homeland. The menu centres on traditional Peruvian classics — ceviche, causa rellena, chicharron, and tamales — alongside breakfast plates and housemade gelato. Its location on a popular urban cycling corridor makes it a convenient stop for riders exploring the waterfront.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and confirms an active Peruvian restaurant with a full menu and delivery partners (Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, Uber Eats), supporting takeout. Multiple vegetarian dishes appear on the menu (causa rellena de vegetales, salpicon de verduras, yuquita frita). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities, so those are left null. A minor name discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Silvestre Deli & Bistro' while the website identifies the business as 'silvestre – Peruvian Cuisine' / 'Silvestre Restaurant'.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Silvestre Deli & Bistro' but the website identifies the business as 'silvestre – Peruvian Cuisine' and 'Silvestre Restaurant'. The OSM name may be outdated or imprecise.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Peruvian restaurant on Water Street in Gastown with an active website and menu. Useful to touring cyclists as a food stop on a popular urban cycling route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetarian options: causa rellena de vegetales, salpicon de verduras, yuquita frita (fried yuca), and egg-based breakfast dishes
